correctness.rationale: Under FIK semantics, diamond thresholds recover nonempty rows and their maxima; global box thresholds recover every suffix minimum. These sequences are necessarily weakly increasing, and their interlacing permits a two-successor representative. The canonical representative realizes exactly the same operations; differing invariants are separated by a one-modal-operator atom formula. Hook-content/MacMahon counts all pairs. Outdegree-one classes are exactly diagonal pairs, giving the central binomial count. All 66,066 relations for n<=4 were enumerated; ordered pairs through n<=6 match the formula. Computations corroborate, not replace, the proof.

value.rationale: This classifies the observable modal algebra on every finite Heyting chain, not all syntactic relational choices. It shows an exact and sharp compression of potentially many-successor frames to outdegree two, and identifies precisely when even one successor suffices. The complete plane-partition count and central-binomial boundary are motivated canonical invariants, beyond a routine raw relation census.
